# Events

Avro record schemas the engine emits — the business payload only (the CloudEvents envelope rides in Kafka headers). Generated from `contracts/avro/`.

| Event | Summary |
|---|---|
| [`deposits.term_deposit.DepositConstituted`](./deposits.term_deposit.DepositConstituted.md) | The deposit is opened: principal, the rate-sheet-resolved TAN, and the AT_MATURITY schedule fixed at constitution. Business payload only ([ADR-IC-002](../../../product-management/integration_concepts/adrs/ADR-IC-002-schema-format-and-registry.md) §P5); CloudEvents envelope rides in Kafka headers, NOT here. No PII ([ADR-PC-004](../../../product-management/product_concepts/adrs/ADR-PC-004-pii-crypto-shredding.md) §P2). |
| [`deposits.term_deposit.DepositMatured`](./deposits.term_deposit.DepositMatured.md) | The deposit matures and pays out: TotalPayout = Principal + NetInterest. Business payload only ([ADR-IC-002](../../../product-management/integration_concepts/adrs/ADR-IC-002-schema-format-and-registry.md) §P5); no PII ([ADR-PC-004](../../../product-management/product_concepts/adrs/ADR-PC-004-pii-crypto-shredding.md) §P2). |
| [`deposits.term_deposit.InterestPaid`](./deposits.term_deposit.InterestPaid.md) | Interest is paid out — the coarse coupon/advance payout fact (the periodic/coupon variant, vs the single AT_MATURITY flow): NetInterest = GrossInterest − WithholdingTax conserved to the cent. PROMOTED to an integration event per [ADR-IC-017](../../../product-management/integration_concepts/adrs/ADR-IC-017-integration-event-promotion-criterion.md) §P4 (coarse business fact; GL/accounting, notifications, and reporting react to it). The integration-relevant withholding AMOUNT rides here on withholding_tax_cents — the fine-grained WithholdingApplied/InterestAccrued accrual mechanics stay internal/store-only. Business payload only ([ADR-IC-002](../../../product-management/integration_concepts/adrs/ADR-IC-002-schema-format-and-registry.md) §P5); CloudEvents envelope rides in Kafka headers, NOT here. No PII ([ADR-PC-004](../../../product-management/product_concepts/adrs/ADR-PC-004-pii-crypto-shredding.md) §P2): deposit_id is an opaque reference, never depositor identity. |
| [`deposits.term_deposit.PersonalDataErasureRequested`](./deposits.term_deposit.PersonalDataErasureRequested.md) | GDPR Article 17 right-to-be-forgotten was exercised on this deposit: the subject's encryption key was crypto-shredded (IPiiKeyStore.DestroyKeyAsync, [ADR-PC-004](../../../product-management/product_concepts/adrs/ADR-PC-004-pii-crypto-shredding.md) §P3), so all PII ciphertext under it is permanently unrecoverable; only non-personal structural fields remain queryable. Business payload only ([ADR-IC-002](../../../product-management/integration_concepts/adrs/ADR-IC-002-schema-format-and-registry.md) §P5); CloudEvents envelope rides in Kafka headers, NOT here. No PII ([ADR-PC-004](../../../product-management/product_concepts/adrs/ADR-PC-004-pii-crypto-shredding.md) §P2): subject_pseudonym is a salted one-way hash, NEVER the raw subject id. |
| [`loans.credito_pessoal.LoanDisbursed`](./loans.credito_pessoal.LoanDisbursed.md) | The loan is disbursed: the lump-sum principal is paid out and the closed-end French-system amortization schedule is fixed at constitution (fin-math §4.1). The closed-end-asset analogue of term_deposit.DepositConstituted. Business payload only ([ADR-IC-002](../../../product-management/integration_concepts/adrs/ADR-IC-002-schema-format-and-registry.md) §P5); CloudEvents envelope rides in Kafka headers, NOT here. No PII ([ADR-PC-004](../../../product-management/product_concepts/adrs/ADR-PC-004-pii-crypto-shredding.md) §P2). Origination stays upstream ([ADR-PC-030](../../../product-management/product_concepts/adrs/ADR-PC-030-product-scope-and-boundary.md) / [ADR-PC-024](../../../product-management/product_concepts/adrs/ADR-PC-024-constitution-precondition-contract.md)) — the loan arrives already approved and priced. |
| [`loans.credito_pessoal.LoanInstallmentPaid`](./loans.credito_pessoal.LoanInstallmentPaid.md) | One scheduled installment is paid: the period's interest + capital split (P(t) = J(t) + A(t), fin-math §3) and the outstanding balance after it. The amortization kernel computed the split command-side; the event records the already-computed facts. Business payload only ([ADR-IC-002](../../../product-management/integration_concepts/adrs/ADR-IC-002-schema-format-and-registry.md) §P5); CloudEvents envelope rides in Kafka headers. No PII ([ADR-PC-004](../../../product-management/product_concepts/adrs/ADR-PC-004-pii-crypto-shredding.md) §P2). |
| [`loans.credito_pessoal.LoanRepaidEarly`](./loans.credito_pessoal.LoanRepaidEarly.md) | The borrower repays the loan early (fin-math §7.5): a partial or full prepayment of the outstanding capital plus the LEGALLY-CAPPED early-repayment commission (PT consumer-credit caps: 0.50% >1y remaining / 0.25% ≤1y, capped further at the lost interest). A full repayment drives the balance to zero (the loan then settles). Business payload only ([ADR-IC-002](../../../product-management/integration_concepts/adrs/ADR-IC-002-schema-format-and-registry.md) §P5); CloudEvents envelope rides in Kafka headers. No PII ([ADR-PC-004](../../../product-management/product_concepts/adrs/ADR-PC-004-pii-crypto-shredding.md) §P2). |
| [`loans.credito_pessoal.LoanSettled`](./loans.credito_pessoal.LoanSettled.md) | The loan is fully amortized and settled (terminal): the outstanding balance reached zero through the final scheduled installment or a full early repayment. The closed-end-asset analogue of term_deposit.DepositMatured. Business payload only ([ADR-IC-002](../../../product-management/integration_concepts/adrs/ADR-IC-002-schema-format-and-registry.md) §P5); CloudEvents envelope rides in Kafka headers. No PII ([ADR-PC-004](../../../product-management/product_concepts/adrs/ADR-PC-004-pii-crypto-shredding.md) §P2). |
| [`loans.credito_pessoal.PersonalDataErasureRequested`](./loans.credito_pessoal.PersonalDataErasureRequested.md) | The data subject's GDPR Article 17 right-to-be-forgotten was exercised on this loan: the subject's encryption key was crypto-shredded ([ADR-PC-004](../../../product-management/product_concepts/adrs/ADR-PC-004-pii-crypto-shredding.md) §P3), so every PII ciphertext under it is now permanently unrecoverable. The erasure FACT is structural-only (no field was, or could resolve to, the erased personal data), so it may itself ride the durable bus as a cascade signal. Business payload only ([ADR-IC-002](../../../product-management/integration_concepts/adrs/ADR-IC-002-schema-format-and-registry.md) §P5); CloudEvents envelope rides in Kafka headers. No PII ([ADR-PC-004](../../../product-management/product_concepts/adrs/ADR-PC-004-pii-crypto-shredding.md) §P2). |
